lines: 1 delivered file carries no source map, so their bytes are charged only where the code shows its origin by itself: the glue of the bundler, code of the bundler and its plugins.
No package is imported as a whole: every package contributes only the modules that are used (120 packages, 1,447 modules).
On this measure the form of importing is exhausted. A root import whose barrel the bundler removes completely leaves no trace, so this is evidence, not proof.
No module is delivered twice inside one page.
No bundler chunk in dist is left without something that loads it.
